approval_case.title: Bounded break-glass recovery after the owner path fails
approval_case.situation: The normal May-agent owner path failed twice and Telegram reply correlation still needs one bounded repair attempt.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Use one audited attempt scoped to reply correlation, prove it with one canary, then return ownership to may-agent.app.

human_answer: Use one audited break-glass attempt because the normal owner path failed twice. Limit it to restoring Telegram reply correlation, prove it with one canary request and its correctly attached reply, then hand ongoing ownership back to may-agent.app.
